blocks.text: Ingliz tilida otlar ikki guruhga bo'linadi. **Sanaladigan** (countable) otlar — alohida-alohida sanab bo'ladigan narsalar: **an apple**, two **apples**, ten **apples**. **Sanalmaydigan** (uncountable) otlar — modda, massa yoki mavhum tushunchalar: **water**, **rice**, **money**, **music**. Ular **a / an** olmaydi va ko'plikka (`-s`) qo'yilmaydi: «a water», «two rices» deyilmaydi. Bu bo'linish artiklni to'g'ri tanlash uchun asosiy kalit: 69–72-darslardagi barcha qoidalar shunga tayanadi.

O'zbekchada ham bunga o'xshash his bor: «ikkita olma» deymiz, lekin «ikkita suv», «uchta guruch» demaymiz — «ikki stakan suv», «uch kilo guruch» deymiz. Inglizcha ham xuddi shunday ishlaydi: two **glasses of water**, three **kilos of rice**. Farqi shundaki, o'zbekchada bu ixtiyoriy his, inglizchada esa grammatik qoida — u artiklga, ko'plikka va fe'lga ta'sir qiladi.

rows: a bottle, a coin, a song

blocks.text: Sanaladigan otning birlik va ko'plik shakli bor. Birlikda u yolg'iz turmaydi — oldida **a / an** (yoki the, my, this) bo'ladi: **a** chair, **an** egg (65-dars). Ko'plikda `-s` oladi va son bilan ishlatiladi: two chair**s**, five egg**s** (66-dars). Odamlar, hayvonlar, buyumlar, joylar, vaqt birliklari (a day, an hour, a week) — odatda sanaladigan.

items.text: There's **a chair** next to the window.

blocks.text: Sanalmaydigan ot — butun massa yoki tushuncha sifatida o'ylanadigan narsa. Uni bo'laklarga bo'lsangiz ham, har bir bo'lagi yana o'sha narsa: suvning yarmi ham suv, guruchning bir hovuchi ham guruch. Shuning uchun u **a / an** ham, `-s` ham olmaydi va doim **birlik fe'li** bilan keladi: The rice **is** ready. Money **isn't** everything.

rows: water, milk, juice, oil, petrol, air
suv, sut, sharbat, yog', benzin, havo
music, help, time, love, luck, fun, weather
musiqa, yordam, vaqt, sevgi, omad, kulgi, ob-havo
pul, ish, uy vazifasi, tirbandlik, elektr

blocks.text: Ba'zi so'zlar o'zbek o'quvchisini hayron qoldiradi. **money** — sanalmaydi, lekin **a coin** (tanga), **a note** (qog'oz pul), **a dollar** — sanaladi; o'zbekchada ham «ikkita pul» emas, «ikki ming so'm» deymiz. **work** («ish», mehnat) — sanalmaydi, **a job** («ish joyi», lavozim) — sanaladi: I've got **a job**, lekin I've got a lot of **work**. **bread** — sanalmaydi, bitta non — **a loaf** yoki **a piece of bread**.

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «a water», «a bread», «a money» → **water**, **bread**, **money** (artiklsiz); «rices», «breads», «moneys» → **rice**, **bread**, **money**; «The money are on the table» → **The money is** on the table; «I've got a work» → **I've got a job** yoki **I've got (a lot of) work**; «two sugars» (rasmiy matnda) → **two spoons of sugar**.
Qanday sanaymiz: a glass of water, a piece of cake

Sanalmaydigan narsaning miqdorini aytish uchun **idish yoki o'lchov so'zi** + **of** ishlatiladi: **a glass of** water, **a cup of** tea, **a piece of** cake, **a kilo of** rice. Bu o'zbekcha «bir stakan suv», «bir bo'lak tort», «bir kilo guruch» bilan aynan bir xil tuzilma — faqat o'rtada **of** turadi. Sanaladigan bo'lib qoladigan so'z — idish yoki o'lchov, shuning uchun ko'plik ham unga qo'shiladi: two **glasses** of water («two glasses of waters» emas).

items.text: I'd like **a cup of tea**, please.

blocks.text: Kafe va restoranda so'zlashuvda qisqa shakl ham ishlatiladi: **Two coffees**, please = Two cups of coffee. **A water**, please = A bottle / glass of water. Bu faqat buyurtma berishdagi qulaylik; oddiy gapda **some water**, **a glass of water** deyiladi.

Sanalmaydigan ot oldida yo hech narsa turmaydi (umumiy ma'no: Water is important), yo **some** («ozgina», «bir oz» — aniq bo'lmagan miqdor): I need **some water**. Sanaladigan birlik ot bilan esa **a / an**: I need **a bottle**. **some** va uning **a** dan farqi keyingi, 68-darsda; **some / any** batafsil — 76-darsda.

Tekshirish usuli: so'z oldiga «two» qo'yib ko'ring. two apples, two songs — ma'noli → sanaladigan. «two waters», «two musics» — g'alati → sanalmaydigan. O'zbekcha his ham yordam beradi: «ikkita suv» emas, «ikki stakan suv» desangiz — inglizchada ham **two glasses of water**.

rows: **a glass of** water, **a kilo of** rice

examples.title: Countable: **a chair**, four **chairs**
examples.description: Sanaladigan otlar: birlikda **a / an**, ko'plikda `-s`, son bilan bemalol ishlatiladi: a biscuit, two phones, five peaches.

sentences.text: Would you like **a biscuit** with your tea?
sentences.translation: Choy bilan **pechenye** olasizmi?

sentences.text: There are four **chairs** and a big **table** in the kitchen.
sentences.translation: Oshxonada to'rtta **stul** va katta **stol** bor.

sentences.text: Bekzod has got **a laptop** and two **phones**.
sentences.translation: Bekzodning **noutbuki** va ikkita **telefoni** bor.

sentences.text: How many **eggs** do we need for the cake? — Three.
sentences.translation: Tort uchun nechta **tuxum** kerak? — Uchta.

sentences.text: Madina bought **a melon** and five **peaches** at the market.
sentences.translation: Madina bozordan bitta **qovun** va beshta **shaftoli** oldi.

sentences.text: Excuse me, is there **a toilet** in this café?
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, bu kafeda **hojatxona** bormi?

sentences.text: My grandparents have got **a cow**, two **goats** and a lot of **chickens**.
sentences.translation: Bobom va buvimning bitta **sigiri**, ikkita **echkisi** va juda ko'p **tovug'i** bor.

sentences.text: We need two **onions** and a kilo of **carrots** for the plov.
sentences.translation: Osh uchun ikkita **piyoz** va bir kilo **sabzi** kerak.

sentences.text: Emma reads **a book** every week, so she's read fifty **books** this year.
sentences.translation: Emma har hafta bitta **kitob** o'qiydi, shuning uchun bu yil ellikta **kitob** o'qib bo'ldi.

sentences.text: Each **room** in the hotel has got **a bed**, **a desk** and two **windows**.
sentences.translation: Mehmonxonaning har bir **xonasida** **karavot**, **yozuv stoli** va ikkita **deraza** bor.

examples.title: Uncountable: **water**, **rice**, **money**
examples.description: Moddalar va oziq-ovqat — sanalmaydi: **a / an** ham, `-s` ham olmaydi, fe'l birlikda (**is**): The cheese **is** good.

sentences.text: Don't drink **water** from the tap here.
sentences.translation: Bu yerda jo'mrakdan **suv** ichmang.

sentences.text: **Rice** is the most important thing in plov.
sentences.translation: Oshda eng muhim narsa — **guruch**.

sentences.text: I haven't got any **money** for a taxi.
sentences.translation: Taksiga **pulim** yo'q.

sentences.text: Do you take **sugar** in your coffee?
sentences.translation: Qahvangizga **shakar** solasizmi?

sentences.text: This **milk** smells bad — don't drink it!
sentences.translation: Bu **sut** yomon hid chiqaryapti — ichma!

sentences.text: There's **sand** in my shoes after the beach.
sentences.translation: Plyajdan keyin poyabzalimga **qum** kirib qolibdi.

sentences.text: Aziz puts a lot of **salt** on everything he eats.
sentences.translation: Aziz yeydigan hamma narsasiga ko'p **tuz** sepadi.

sentences.text: Our old car uses a lot of **petrol**.
sentences.translation: Eski mashinamiz ko'p **benzin** yeydi.

sentences.text: In an Uzbek home there's always **bread** on the table.
sentences.translation: O'zbek xonadonida dasturxonda doim **non** bo'ladi.

sentences.text: The **cheese** in this shop is good, but the **meat** isn't fresh.
sentences.translation: Bu do'konda **pishloq** yaxshi, lekin **go'sht** yangi emas.

examples.title: Uncountable ideas: **music**, **help**, **time**
examples.description: Mavhum tushunchalar ham sanalmaydi: music, help, time, weather, luck, fun, traffic, homework, work. «a help», «a homework», «a work» deyilmaydi.

sentences.text: I listen to **music** on the way to work.
sentences.translation: Ishga ketayotib **musiqa** tinglayman.

sentences.text: Thank you very much for your **help** yesterday.
sentences.translation: Kechagi **yordamingiz** uchun katta rahmat.

sentences.text: Sorry, I haven't got **time** to talk now.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, hozir gaplashishga **vaqtim** yo'q.

sentences.text: What's the **weather** like in London in April?
sentences.translation: Aprelda Londonda **ob-havo** qanday bo'ladi?

sentences.text: There's always a lot of **traffic** in the city centre at six.
sentences.translation: Soat oltida shahar markazida doim **tirbandlik** bo'ladi.

sentences.text: Good **luck** with your exam tomorrow!
sentences.translation: Ertangi imtihoningizga **omad**!

sentences.text: Our teacher gives us a lot of **homework** on Fridays.
sentences.translation: O'qituvchimiz juma kunlari bizga ko'p **uy vazifasi** beradi.

sentences.text: We had great **fun** at Sarah's birthday party.
sentences.translation: Saraning tug'ilgan kunida juda **maza qildik**.

sentences.text: There was no **electricity** in the village for two days.
sentences.translation: Qishloqda ikki kun **elektr** bo'lmadi.

sentences.text: Dilnoza has got a lot of **work** this week, so she can't come to the cinema.
sentences.translation: Dilnozaning bu hafta **ishi** ko'p, shuning uchun kinoga bora olmaydi.

examples.title: **a glass of**, **a cup of**, **a bottle of**
examples.description: Ichimliklar sanalmaydi, lekin idishlar sanaladi: **a glass of** water, **three cups of** tea, **two bottles of** juice — xuddi o'zbekcha «bir stakan suv» kabi.

sentences.text: I'm so thirsty — could I have **a glass of cold water**?
sentences.translation: Juda chanqadim — **bir stakan sovuq suv** bera olasizmi?

sentences.text: My father drinks **three cups of tea** after dinner.
sentences.translation: Otam kechki ovqatdan keyin **uch piyola choy** ichadi.

sentences.text: We bought **two bottles of juice** for the picnic.
sentences.translation: Piknik uchun **ikki shisha sharbat** oldik.

sentences.text: There's **a jug of milk** in the fridge.
sentences.translation: Muzlatgichda **bir grafin sut** bor.

sentences.text: Would you like **a cup of coffee**? — No, thanks, I've just had one.
sentences.translation: **Bir chashka qahva** ichasizmi? — Yo'q, rahmat, hozirgina ichdim.

sentences.text: After the match Tom drank **a whole bottle of water**.
sentences.translation: O'yindan keyin Tom **bir shisha suvni** oxirigacha ichib qo'ydi.

sentences.text: Every morning Madina has **a glass of orange juice**.
sentences.translation: Madina har kuni ertalab **bir stakan apelsin sharbati** ichadi.

sentences.text: How many **cans of lemonade** should I buy for the party?
sentences.translation: Ziyofatga necha **banka limonad** olay?

sentences.text: Excuse me, could we have **two cups of green tea** and **a bottle of mineral water**?
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, bizga **ikki chashka ko'k choy** va **bir shisha mineral suv** bera olasizmi?

sentences.text: In summer I drink at least **two litres of water** a day, because it's so hot in Tashkent.
sentences.translation: Yozda kuniga kamida **ikki litr suv** ichaman, chunki Toshkentda juda issiq bo'ladi.

examples.title: **a piece of**, **a slice of**, **a bar of**
examples.description: Qattiq narsalarning bo'lagi: **a piece of** cake / paper / glass, **a slice of** bread / melon, **a bar of** chocolate / soap, **a bowl of** soup, **a loaf of** bread.

sentences.text: Please have **a piece of cake** — I baked it this morning!
sentences.translation: Marhamat, **bir bo'lak tort** oling — bugun ertalab pishirdim!

sentences.text: I'd like **two slices of bread** with butter, please.
sentences.translation: Menga sariyog' bilan **ikki tilim non** bering, iltimos.

sentences.text: Write your name on **a piece of paper**.
sentences.translation: Ismingizni **bir varaq qog'ozga** yozing.

sentences.text: There's **a bar of chocolate** in my bag — do you want some?
sentences.translation: Sumkamda **bir plitka shokolad** bor — ozgina xohlaysizmi?

sentences.text: When I arrived, Grandma gave me **a big bowl of soup**.
sentences.translation: Kelganimda buvim menga **katta bir kosa sho'rva** berdi.

sentences.text: Mum asked me to buy **a loaf of bread** on the way home.
sentences.translation: Oyim uyga qaytayotganimda **bitta non** olib kelishimni so'radi.

sentences.text: Each of us ate **three slices of watermelon**.
sentences.translation: Har birimiz **uch tilimdan tarvuz** yedik.

sentences.text: Be careful — there's **a piece of glass** on the kitchen floor.
sentences.translation: Ehtiyot bo'ling — oshxona polida **shisha siniqi** bor.

sentences.text: For breakfast James usually has **a bowl of porridge** and **a slice of toast**.
sentences.translation: Jeyms nonushtaga odatda **bir kosa bo'tqa** va **bir tilim qizartirilgan non** yeydi.

sentences.text: There's only **a small piece of soap** in the bathroom, so put it on the shopping list.
sentences.translation: Hammomda faqat **kichkina bir bo'lak sovun** qoldi, uni xaridlar ro'yxatiga yozib qo'y.

examples.title: Shopping: **a kilo of**, **a jar of**, **a packet of**
examples.description: Do'kon va bozordagi o'lchovlar: **a kilo of** rice, **half a kilo of** cheese, **a jar of** honey, **a packet of** biscuits, **a carton of** milk, **a tin of** tomatoes.

sentences.text: Buy **a kilo of rice** and **two kilos of onions**.
sentences.translation: **Bir kilo guruch** va **ikki kilo piyoz** ol.

sentences.text: There's **a jar of honey** on the top shelf.
sentences.translation: Yuqori javonda **bir banka asal** bor.

sentences.text: Sarah always keeps **a packet of biscuits** in her desk.
sentences.translation: Sara stolining tortmasida doim **bir paket pechenye** saqlaydi.

sentences.text: How much is **a carton of milk** here?
sentences.translation: Bu yerda **bir quti sut** necha pul turadi?

sentences.text: Dilnoza came back from the market with **two bags of fruit**.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza bozordan **ikki xalta meva** bilan qaytdi.

sentences.text: We've got **three tins of tomatoes** in the cupboard, so we don't need more.
sentences.translation: Shkafda **uch banka pomidor** bor, boshqa olish shart emas.

sentences.text: Could you get **half a kilo of cheese** too?
sentences.translation: **Yarim kilo pishloq** ham olib kelolasizmi?

sentences.text: Last summer my mother made **ten jars of apricot jam**.
sentences.translation: O'tgan yozda onam **o'n banka o'rik murabbosi** tayyorladi.

sentences.text: I only need **a packet of green tea** and **a box of matches**.
sentences.translation: Menga faqat **bir quti ko'k choy** va **bir quti gugurt** kerak.

sentences.text: At Chorsu Bazaar **a kilo of beef** costs more than **a kilo of chicken**.
sentences.translation: Chorsu bozorida **bir kilo mol go'shti** **bir kilo tovuq go'shtidan** qimmatroq.

examples.title: Countable or uncountable? **a job** / **work**
examples.description: Ma'nosi yaqin, lekin turi har xil: **a job** — work, **a song** — music, **a coin** — money, **a meal** — food, **a trip** — travel, **a lamp** — light.

sentences.text: I've got **a new job**, and there's a lot of **work** every day.
sentences.translation: **Yangi ishga** kirdim, har kuni **ish** juda ko'p.

sentences.text: This is **a beautiful song** — I love Uzbek **music**.
sentences.translation: Bu **chiroyli qo'shiq** — men o'zbek **musiqasini** juda yaxshi ko'raman.

sentences.text: Have you got **a coin** for the parking machine? I've got **money**, but only notes.
sentences.translation: Avtoturargoh apparati uchun **tangangiz** bormi? **Pulim** bor, lekin faqat qog'oz pul.

sentences.text: We had **a big meal** at the restaurant, and the **food** was excellent.
sentences.translation: Restoranda **to'yib ovqatlandik**, **taomlar** a'lo edi.

sentences.text: Is there **a bottle** of water in the fridge? — No, but there's some **juice**.
sentences.translation: Muzlatgichda **bir shisha** suv bormi? — Yo'q, lekin ozgina **sharbat** bor.

sentences.text: **Travel** is expensive these days, so we only take one **trip** a year.
sentences.translation: Hozir **sayohat** qimmat, shuning uchun yiliga faqat bir marta **safarga** chiqamiz.

sentences.text: Can you buy **a melon** and some **bread** on your way home?
sentences.translation: Uyga qaytayotib **qovun** va **non** olib kelasanmi?

sentences.text: Aziz isn't looking for **work** — he's got **a good job** at a bank.
sentences.translation: Aziz **ish** qidirmayapti — uning bankda **yaxshi ishi** bor.

sentences.text: There isn't **a lamp** in my room, but a lot of **light** comes through the window.
sentences.translation: Xonamda **chiroq** yo'q, lekin derazadan ko'p **yorug'lik** tushadi.

sentences.text: We don't need **a new car** — we need **time** and **money** for a holiday.
sentences.translation: Bizga **yangi mashina** kerak emas — ta'til uchun **vaqt** va **pul** kerak.

examples.title: Dialogue: at the market
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: bozorda xarid — o'lchov so'zlari (**a kilo of**, **a jar of**, **a piece**), sanalmaydigan otlar (bread, oil, honey, milk) va sanaladigan otlar.

sentences.text: — Good morning! **A kilo of tomatoes**, please.
sentences.translation: — Xayrli tong! **Bir kilo pomidor** bering, iltimos.

sentences.text: — Here you are. Anything else? We've got fresh **bread** today.
sentences.translation: — Marhamat. Yana nima kerak? Bugun yangi **non** bor.

sentences.text: — Great, **two loaves**, please. And **a bottle of sunflower oil**.
sentences.translation: — Zo'r, **ikkita non** bering. Yana **bir shisha kungaboqar yog'i**.

sentences.text: — Sorry, we haven't got **oil**. Try the shop next door.
sentences.translation: — Kechirasiz, bizda **yog'** yo'q. Yonidagi do'konga qarang.

sentences.text: — OK. How much is **a jar of honey**?
sentences.translation: — Mayli. **Bir banka asal** necha pul?

sentences.text: — Forty thousand sum. It's real mountain **honey**.
sentences.translation: — Qirq ming so'm. Bu haqiqiy tog' **asali**.

sentences.text: — Then I'll take **a jar**. Oh, and **half a kilo of cheese**.
sentences.translation: — Unda **bir banka** olaman. Ha, yana **yarim kilo pishloq**.

sentences.text: — Our **cheese** is very good. Would you like to try **a piece**?
sentences.translation: — **Pishlog'imiz** juda yaxshi. **Bir bo'lagini** tatib ko'rasizmi?

sentences.text: — Mmm, delicious! Do you sell **milk** too?
sentences.translation: — Mm, mazali! **Sut** ham sotasizmi?

sentences.text: — Of course — **a litre of milk** is eight thousand sum.
sentences.translation: — Albatta — **bir litr sut** sakkiz ming so'm.
